newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns AA- to Gothenburg $1 bln note programm.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA- to Gothenburg $1 bln note programm.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standand & Poor's (S&P) said on Thursday it had assigned an AA- rating to the City of Gothenburg's $1 billion medium-term note programme with the rating outlook stable.
S&P also affirmed its senior unsecured debt rating of AA- for the city and A-1+ and K-1 for commercial paper ratings.
"The ratings reflect the City of Gothenburg's wealthy and diversified economy, though some concentration in the car and ball-bearing industries makes it somewhat cyclical," S&P said in a statement.
The agency said the ratings also reflected Gothenburg's modest but strongly improved financial performance and moderate tax-supported debt.
"The ratings assume continued careful risk monitoring of electricity trading exposures," it said.
"Political commitment to continued restrained expenditure growth should help the city maintain a sound financial performance."
Gothenburg is Sweden's second largest city.
